name: 3 little worms
description: Dominate the neon grid in this adrenaline-pumping, real-time multiplayer snake game! Compete against players worldwide, strategically collecting orbs to grow your snake and outmaneuver your opponents. Optimized for seamless mobile gameplay, this isn't just a game; it's an immersive experience. We've packed it with unique features and engaging activities to keep you hooked, from power-ups that change the rules to dynamic grid transformations and exciting mini-games that pop up during matches. Get ready to slither your way to victory!
